_comment: Every generation zombie study 02 ran, kept or not, in the order it ran. `init` is the
paint-over guide uploaded as the init image; init_image_strength is how much of it the model
keeps (higher is closer). Sizes are the 1x atlas: transparency failed above about 65536 px of
area, so the sheets were never run at 2x.

generations.why: a free reinterpretation: the identity drifted and the shading flattened against the pack
generations.description: sprite sheet grid of the same screamer zombie woman, top-down 3/4 pixel art game sprites: gaunt emaciated pale grey-white skin, bald head with a few wispy strands of hair, huge black gaping screaming mouth open wide, torn faded pink hospital gown, bare bony legs, dark near-black stepped outline, muted desaturated colors, rusty red blood stains

generations.why: a recolour of the heavy, no bloat, and a face on the north row
generations.description: sprite sheet grid of the same bloater zombie, top-down 3/4 pixel art game sprites: hugely bloated swollen obese body, enormous distended round gas-filled belly, sickly yellow-green mottled blistered skin with dark purple veins and pustules, shirtless, tattered dark trousers, small head sunk into fat shoulders, dark near-black stepped outline, muted desaturated colors

generations.why: not kept; superseded by the strength-300 pass over the final guide
generations.description: sprite sheet of one screamer zombie in twenty poses, same layout, same chunky dark-outlined top-down game style: emaciated woman zombie, sickly pale grey-blue skin, thin stringy dark hair, mouth stretched wide open in a scream showing a black hole, torn stained off-white hospital gown to the knees, bare grey shins, dried rusty blood down the chin and gown

generations.why: rows south, east and west kept; its north row drew a face and was replaced by the pass below
generations.description: sprite sheet of one bloater zombie in twenty walking poses, same layout: grotesquely bloated obese zombie with a huge swollen round gas-filled belly, sickly yellow-green mottled skin with purple veins and blisters, shirtless, torn dark grey trousers, brown boots, small head, chunky near-black stepped outline, muted colors, top-down 3/4 game sprite

row of five sprites of one bloater zombie seen from BEHIND walking away, back view, no face visible: back of a small bald head, torn dark brown vest over the upper back, hugely swollen yellow-green mottled flanks and lower back bulging out at both sides, purple veins, torn dark grey trousers, brown boots, chunky near-black stepped outline, top-down 3/4 game sprite

sprite sheet of one screamer zombie in twenty walking poses, same layout: emaciated woman zombie in a torn stained white hospital gown to the knees, bloodless grey-blue skin, bare grey shins, long stringy black hair, mouth stretched wide open screaming, rusty blood down the chin and gown, chunky near-black stepped outline, muted colors, top-down 3/4 game sprite

generations.why: blurred the outline and lost the head; the guide is used as drawn
generations.description: two dead zombie corpses lying flat on the ground side by side, same zombie: emaciated woman zombie in a torn stained pale grey hospital gown, long stringy black hair, bloodless grey skin, dark leggings, rusty blood stains; left lying on her back, right lying face down; chunky near-black stepped outline, muted colors, top-down 3/4 game sprites

generations.why: blurred, and the supine head dissolved into the mound
generations.description: two dead bloater zombie corpses lying flat on the ground side by side, same zombie: grotesquely bloated obese zombie with a huge swollen round belly, sickly yellow-green mottled skin with purple veins, torn dark brown vest, dark grey trousers, brown boots; left lying on his back with the belly up, right lying face down with swollen flanks; chunky near-black stepped outline, muted colors, top-down 3/4 game sprites

generations.why: closer, still lost the head; the guide is used as drawn
generations.description: two dead bloater zombie corpses lying flat on the ground, same zombie: obese zombie with a swollen round belly, sickly yellow-green mottled skin, torn dark brown vest, dark grey trousers, brown boots; left lying on his back with the bloated belly up and head to the left, right lying face down with swollen flanks; chunky near-black stepped outline, muted colors, top-down game sprites
